title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Letar du efter en arbetsplats för framtiden?

Hos oss är karriären din. Här får du möjlighet att styra den i riktningen du drömmer om och samtidigt vara delaktig i tekniska innovationer som idag knappt ens finns i fantasin. Innovationer som vi vet kommer rita om kartan för hur vi kommunicerar med varandra och lever våra uppkopplade liv i framtiden. Letar du efter en arbetsplats där du får vara med och bidra till det viktigaste som finns – relationerna människor emellan? Välkommen till oss på Telenor.

Nu letar vi efter dig som vill bli Senior Platform Engineer i vårt team IP-Services.

Så kommer du göra skillnad med oss

NMS-IP är Telenors centrala plattform för drift, övervakning och styrning av IP‑infrastrukturen. Plattformen är affärs‑ och samhällskritisk och en viktig del av Sveriges digitala kommunikationsinfrastruktur, där hög tillgänglighet, robusthet och stabil drift är avgörande.

I rollen som Senior Platform Engineer arbetar du med arkitektur, vidareutveckling och daglig drift av plattformen. Du driver tekniska vägval samtidigt som du är hands‑on i miljöerna. Plattformen är helt on‑prem och körs i Telenors egna datacenter, vilket innebär ett nära samarbete mellan plattform, underliggande infrastruktur och nätverk.

Rollen innebär tätt samarbete med datacenterteam, IP‑nätverksteam samt andra plattforms‑ och säkerhetsteam. Genom ditt arbete bidrar du direkt till en trygg, stabil och tillförlitlig nätinfrastruktur för Telenors kunder och samhällsviktiga tjänster.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi behöver dig som är på tårna! Du har en genuin vilja att lära och utvecklas så att vi kan möta kunders ständigt föränderliga behov – idag och imorgon.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Gedigen erfarenhet (5 år+) av Linuxsystemadministration, gärna Red Hat

  • Erfarenhet av virtualisering (5 år+), främst VMware

  • Erfarenhet av drift (5 år+) av affärs‑ eller samhällskritiska plattformar

  • Förmåga att arbeta både med arkitektur och operativ drift

  • Erfarenhet av Automatisering och IaC, exempelvis Ansible

  • Erfarenhet av implementering av övervakningslösningar och systemnära verktyg

Meriterande

  • Containerplattformar såsom Kubernetes/K3S

  • Git och CI/CD‑flöden, exempelvis GitLab

  • Erfarenhet av nätverk eller IP‑miljöer (meriterande men inte ett krav)

För denna roll krävs det att du bor i Sverige och har rätt att arbeta här (rollen omfattar samhällsbärande infrastruktur och beredskap). Du behöver tala god svenska i tal och skrift. Placeringsort är i Stockholm, Umeå, Karlskrona eller Karlskoga.

Vårt löfte till dig

Vi är bättre tillsammans. Hos oss möts du av en familjär och inkluderande kultur, en stark gemensam värdegrund och ett ledarskap som ger dig frihet och handlingskraft. Vi tror på att ge varandra förtroende och frihet att agera och fatta beslut, samtidigt som vi är där för varandra i med- och motgångar.

Vi stöttar relationer och samhällen. Telenor är ett samhällsbärande företag och här får ditt arbete ett större syfte. Vi skapar värde för miljoner människor varje dag och har ett kundnära förhållningssätt där mänskliga relationer står i centrum.

Vi ger plats för livet. Arbeta hemifrån två dagar i veckan om du vill, så länge dina arbetsuppgifter gör det möjligt. Resten av tiden skapar vi magi tillsammans på kontoret. Ledarskap baserat på tillit och flexibla arbetstider hjälper dig att balansera jobbet och livet. Vi finns där genom livets alla faser och erbjuder trygghetspaket i form av bl.a. kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet att skräddarsy försäkringslösningar som passar just dig, för ditt behov här och nu.

Vi bjuder in till en spännande karriärresa. Din utveckling står i centrum och hos oss är lärande en del av kulturen. Vi avsätter 40 timmar om året för att du ska kunna fördjupa dig, utforska nya områden och växa i din roll. Genom Telenor Academy och andra lärandeinitiativ får du verktygen och friheten att forma din egen karriär. När du vill vidare väntar möjligheter i hela Norden. 

Sök till oss idag

Vill du ta ditt nästa steg i karriären med oss? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Vi träffar kandidater löpande så hör av dig redan idag.

Om du har frågor och vill veta mer är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande ledare William Pont på william.pont@telenor.se. Vi kan tyvärr inte ta emot ansökan via mejl. Sista ansökningsdag är 19:e maj 2026.

Bra att känna till

Enligt Telenors policy genomför vi bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat i samtliga rekryteringar.

Vi stöttar relationer och samhällen. Telenor är ett samhällsbärande företag och här får ditt arbete ett större syfte. Vi skapar värde för miljoner människor varje dag och har ett kundnära förhållningssätt där mänskliga relationer står i centrum.

Vi ger plats för livet. Vi finns där genom livets alla faser och erbjuder trygghetspaket i form av bl.a. kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet att skräddarsy försäkringslösningar som passar just dig, för ditt behov här och nu. Som tillsvidareanställd har du dessutom vår förmån "två give-me-a-break-days" per år som ger dig en extra paus med möjlighet till återhämtning och välmående.

Vi bjuder in till en spännande karriärresa. Din utveckling står i centrum och hos oss är lärande en del av kulturen. I butikerna fokuserar vi på att coacha, utveckla och ge dig rätt verktyg för att trivas och växa. Telenor erbjuder både fysiska och digitala utbildningar anpassade för just din utvecklingsresa. Genom Växa, vår utbildningsplattform, och andra lärandeinitiativ får du därmed möjligheten att utvecklas och forma din egen karriär. Majoriteten av våra tjänster tillsätts internt så när du vill vidare väntar möjligheterna här. 

Sök till oss idag       

Vill du ta ditt nästa steg i karriären med oss? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Vi träffar kandidater löpande så hör av dig redan idag. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via mejl.

Om du går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du få göra tre tester som fokuserar på din personlighet och färdigheter. Enligt Telenors policy genomför vi även bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat i samtliga rekryteringar.

title: Datacenter Engineers – Database Platforms
description:
Looking for a workplace for the future?

At Telenor, your career is truly your own. Here, you have the opportunity to shape it in the direction you aspire to, while contributing to technological innovations that today barely exist even in imagination – innovations that we know will redefine how we communicate and live our connected lives in the future.

If you’re looking for a workplace where you can be part of creating what matters most – the connections between people – then welcome to Telenor.

We are now looking for Datacenter Engineers to join our Database Platform function within the Datacenter Infrastructure team.

How you’ll make a difference with us

We are hiring two hands-on datacenter engineers focused on database platforms. You will operate and improve our ‘database hotel’ with emphasis on Oracle in Linux/Unix environments (Solaris may occur) and/or MSSQL on Windows. The role blends database operations with automation and stable infrastructure, working closely with application teams for proper service levels and change management.

You will have a primary focus (your core), but you will work as part of one team jointly accountable for incidents, changes, performance, recovery and clear documentation. Automation and efficiency are part of the job regardless of core — standardizing workflows, improving repeatable tasks and using scripts/tools where it adds quality and predictability.

Daily tasks will include running stable day‑to‑day operations such as installation, patching and updates, performance and capacity work, and incident handling. You will ensure compliance with all monitoring standards as well as reliable backup and restore capabilities, perform validation and recovery drills. You will also work cross‑functionally with platform and infrastructure teams (e.g., virtualization and storage) for troubleshooting and capacity planning. Standardizing and automating recurring tasks — through scripts, templates, and standard changes — as well as documenting runbooks and playbooks and sharing knowledge across the team, will be a natural part of your work. You will be expected to develop and maintain monitoring and automation scripts, including Shell scripts, PowerShell, and Ansible playbooks, to ensure predictability, quality, and efficiency in day‑to‑day operations. You will also be responsible for managing the full lifecycle of databases.

We are currently looking to fill two roles within the following focus areas, or ‘cores’, in the team:

1) Oracle & Linux (Unix/Solaris may occur)

In this role, you will focus on operating and improving our Oracle environments on Linux/Unix platforms. Your work will include Oracle database installation, patching, capacity and performance management, as well as ensuring reliable backup and restore processes using tools such as RMAN and Data Pump. You will also make sure that the Linux/Unix platform is correctly configured for Oracle — including filesystems, kernel parameters and required packages — and you will validate recovery capabilities through regular drills.

2) MSSQL & Windows

In this role, you will focus on operating and developing our MSSQL services on Windows platforms. Your responsibilities include day‑to‑day MSSQL operations such as installation, patching, capacity planning, and performance optimization through indexes, statistics, and query tuning. You will ensure robust HA/DR and recovery capabilities using technologies such as Always On Availability Groups and log shipping, and you will regularly conduct recovery tests to verify that restoration works in practice. You will also administer Windows Server from an operational perspective and manage standard changes in virtualized environments.

Are you the one we’re looking for?

We need someone who’s always on their toes! You have a genuine desire to learn and develop so we can continue to meet our customers’ ever-changing needs – today and tomorrow. We are seeking hands-on candidates with solid experience in database operations and platform engineering (minimum 3 years of experience). Suitable backgrounds typically combine technical depth with structured ways of working in operational environments. Relevant educational backgrounds include, for example, Computer Science/Information Systems, IT Infrastructure/Datacenter Engineering, or specialized database and OS-focused programs. Typical previous roles may include Database Administrator/Engineer (Oracle or MSSQL), Linux/Unix or Windows Server Operations Engineer, or Infrastructure/Platform Engineer with responsibilities in virtualization, storage, backup/recovery, or automation.

Both roles follow regular office hours but may require on-call duty when needed. The position is based at either our Stockholm or Karlskrona office, with the option for hybrid work. Swedish proficiency is not mandatory but seen as a plus, while strong English proficiency is required.

We’d love to see

We’re looking for someone who enjoys combining operations with improvements and standardization in a hands-on role and likes to automate and make work more predictable (scripts, IaC thinking where relevant). It’s valued that you work in a structured way with documentation and quality-assured changes. Having the ability to communicate clearly and collaborate well with application and adjacent platform teams.

Traits that help you thrive

· Structured and thorough, focused on stable and efficient workflows.

· Analytical and solution-oriented.

· Collaborative and communicative.

· Good prioritization and calm under incidents.

Our promise to you We are better together. With us, you’ll be welcomed by a warm and inclusive culture, a strong shared set of values, and leadership that gives you freedom and empowerment. We believe in trusting one another and giving the space to act and make decisions — while being there for each other through both successes and challenges.

We support relationships and communities. Telenor is a company with an important role in society, and your work here carries a greater purpose. We create value for millions of people every day and take a customer‑centric approach where human connections are at the core.

We make room for life. Work from home two days a week if you like, as long as your role allows it. The rest of the time, we create magic together at the office. Leadership built on trust and flexible working hours help you balance work and life. We support you through all stages of life and offer security through collective agreements, occupational pension, wellness allowance, and the opportunity to tailor insurance solutions that fit your needs here and now.”

We invite you on an exciting career journey. Your development is at the center, and learning is part of our culture. We set aside 40 hours each year for you to deepen your skills, explore new areas, and grow in your role. Through Telenor Academy and other learning initiatives, you get the tools and freedom to shape your own career. And when you’re ready for your next step, opportunities await across the Nordics.

Apply today Ready to take the next step in your career with us? We look forward to receiving your application! We review candidates on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to reach out today.

If you have any questions, you’re welcome to contact the hiring manager Magnus Karlsson at magnus.karlsson@telenor.se or +46709614311. Unfortunately, we’re not able to accept applications via email.

Good to know According to Telenor’s policy, a background check is carried out on the final candidate in all recruitments

title: System Engineer within Kubernetes

About you

We believe that you are passionate about solving technical challenges and have effective communication skills when cooperating across teams. You thrive in a changing environment and independently drive your own and your team's work forward.

To feel comfortable in this position, you have probably had a background as a software or solution architect and would like to take next step. You also at this point have acquired the ability to handle multiple stakeholders with different needs, at various seniority levels (from C-suite to developers). You should be comfortable in setting direction and vision, helping others to execute it, and be able to act as a mentor and coach to other architects. Presentation skills and communication skills are key as you will need to collaborate and influence those around you, all with the goal of reaching the future vision of your product. title: IAM Engineer within operations
description:
Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. The position
We are seeking an IAM Engineer to manage and maintain our enterprise IAM services, ensuring secure, reliable, and compliant identity solutions for internal and external stakeholders. You will be a part of our IT Security team and in this role, you will work closely with stakeholders such as IT Operations and IAM architects.

As an IAM Engineer, you will drive operational excellence, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of our identity and access services. Your work ensures secure and efficient access to critical systems—strengthening Swedish healthcare and contributing to a safer society.

In addition, you will take a hands-on role in implementing configuration changes, integrating systems, and maintaining secure operations while ensuring high availability across IAM and PAM platforms. Working closely with infrastructure, code, CI/CD pipelines, and automation, you will continuously enhance and streamline our identity landscape to support a resilient and future-ready environment.

  • A collaborative, international environment where you’ll be part of a diverse and inclusive team that values knowledge sharing and teamwork to drive innovation. You’ll work with passionate professionals across borders in a global setting. 

  • Grow your expertise in IAM and security while making a real impact. You’ll deepen your knowledge in Identity and Access Management and help deliver secure, reliable solutions for Swedish healthcare. Your work will strengthen data protection and trust in critical systems—making a difference for thousands of patients and healthcare professionals every day. 


Responsibilites

  • Manage and maintain Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms, including Identity Provider (IdP) services, with responsibilities spanning certificate lifecycle management and federation configuration. 

  • Manage and maintain Privileged Access Management (PAM) integrating with Entra, Active Directory, and other directory services. 

  • Diagnose and resolve authentication and authorization issues within complex environments. 

  • Implement configuration changes and facilitate the onboarding of new customers and services. 

  • Conduct thorough functional testing after updates to ensure uninterrupted service delivery.

You bring hands-on technical expertise in IAM, PAM, and directory services, complemented by strong troubleshooting and scripting skills. Most importantly, you are customer-focused, ready to engage directly with clients and provide expert guidance on IAM-related questions.

  • Proven hands-on experience implementing and operating IAM technologies (IdPs/IdBs, federation, authentication flows).

title: Credit Risk Analyst SME
description:
Are you a challenger who wants to shape the future of credit risk for Business Loans to Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SME)?

At Nordax Bank, we believe in simplicity, transparency, and technology-driven innovation. As part of NOBA Bank Group, we offer consumer loans, credit cards, savings accounts and insurance – all made available through cutting-edge technology, automation, and seamless self-service platforms.

With over 2 million customers across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Germany, and Spain, we’re proud to be part of the largest independent specialist consumer finance lender in the Nordics – and we’re just getting started.

This is an opportunity to join a bank that is growing fast and shaping the future of Small Medium Enterprises (SME) business loans in the Nordics.

Why join us?

We put professional development at the core of our success. At Nordax, you’ll find an international and friendly workplace with a flat structure, informal culture and high level of trust and autonomy. We’re currently around 200 employees at Bank Norwegian, and over 600 across the Nordax Bank.

Our culture is built on collaboration, curiosity, and shared success — and we’re proud to live by our values:

💛 We are wholehearted

🤝 We collaborate

🚀 We take the lead

About the team

Our Credit & Analytics department is known for being one of the most forward-thinking in the Nordics, made up of talents from across the globe. Within this department, the Credit Underwriting & Decision Analytics unit focuses on continuously improving our automated underwriting processes and monitoring risk performance.

We are now launching our SME business loans in the Nordics. As we build this business from the ground up, we’re looking for a Credit Risk Analyst SME with strong credit risk experience within the corporate lending business to play a key role in shaping our future solutions, policies, and risk strategies. This is a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of a new business area and make a real impact from day one.

What you’ll be doing

  • Play a central role in developing and launching the SME business loans in the Nordics

  • Collaborate with business, product, and cross-functional teams on projects and initiatives, providing credit risk expertise into business decisions

  • Work with data and data structures to ensure we have the right foundation for monitoring SME credit risk and processes, and to connect these insights directly to business and credit risk outcomes

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of credit risk strategies, tools, process improvements and efficiency

  • Develop and enhance data-driven monitoring and reporting to support proactive risk management for SME portfolios as the business grows

  • Understand how data flows through our systems and processes, and leverage this knowledge to identify business opportunities, improve decision-making, and optimize operations

  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Collaborate on various tasks within Credit Underwriting & Decision Analytics to support our continuous improvement journey

What we’re looking for

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience working within credit risk and the credit environment for SME business loans in the Swedish market

  • In-depth knowledge of credit risk assessment, credit bureau data, regulatory requirements, and market-specific credit risk factors related to SME loans

  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret complex data and present findings clearly

  • Fluency in English (Scandinavian language skills is a plus)

  • Strong communication skills – ability to explain complex findings in an understandable way

  • Working experience from using analytical tools such R, Python, SAS or SQL/Databricks

  • A degree in a quantitative field (Economics, Finance, Statistics, Data Science or similar)

  • Experience with fraud detection, prevention, and related controls within the SME loans is a strong plus

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with reporting tools such as Tableau or Power BI

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP)

Who you are

You are creative, curious, and have strong analytical skills. You enjoy using data to challenge and improve existing methods and are eager to drive business improvements. You have a talent for seeing how data flows through and impacts business processes, and you use this understanding to identify opportunities, solve problems, and create value. You thrive in a collaborative environment, working closely with colleagues from different backgrounds, and are comfortable taking initiative and responsibility in projects. You have a commercial mindset and are motivated by making a tangible impact on both risk management and business outcomes.

What we offer

  • A dynamic, international and tech-driven workplace

  • Significant responsibility as being for a portfolio

  • Great collaboration with experienced and supportive colleagues

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid setup

  • A flat and informal organization with a startup mentality — but with the stability of an established bank

title: People Business Partner (Vikariat) till NOBA Bank Group

Dina direktrapporterande kommer till en början att vara lönespecialister- och administratörer, People Coordinators på deltid samt en People Operations Partner. Vi ser redan nu att teamet kommer att fortsätta växa, vilket ger dig möjlighet att sätta din prägel på er resa framåt. 🌱

Inom People Operations & Payroll finns flera viktiga ansvarsområden:

  • Leverera pålitlig, teknikdriven och högkvalitativ People service gentemot ledare, kollegor och medarbetare.

  • Säkerställa compliance genom teknikdrivna arbetsflöden, automation och data, samt genom att säkerställa att våra processer följer legala och organisatoriska krav.

  • Bidra till rapportering inom koncernen.

  • Utveckla policys, arbetssätt och processer för att säkerställa skalbarhet i en tillväxtorganisation.

Som ledare får du en central roll i att forma teamet och dess framtida riktning. Du får möjlighet att bygga din organisation, implementera tydliga arbetsrutiner och ansvarsfördelning samt skapa ett välfungerande samarbete. 🤝🏽Du visar vägen när det gäller att sätta strukturer, bygga rutiner och utveckla arbetsflöden – allt med tekniken som hjälpmedel och mottagaren i fokus. Vi uppmuntrar till att ifrågasätta invanda arbetssätt, främja innovation och prioritera rätt saker i rätt tid. Vi ser stor potential i vad du och teamet kan åstadkomma tillsammans och vill därför träffa dig som är orädd och har en stor vilja att göra skillnad. 🫧

Ledarskapserfarenhet: Du har ett par års erfarenhet av att inspirera, stötta och utveckla medarbetare inom People/Payroll, och ser dig själv som ledare snarare än chef.

Kunskap inom HR-processer: Du har mycket god förståelse för kärnprocesser (anställning till avslut), arbetsmiljö, compliance, revisioner, master data och people tech. 🛠️

title: Treasury Analyst within Middle Office to NOBA Bank Group
description:
NOBA has experienced rapid growth over the years, and our Treasury function has evolved in both complexity and scope. We are now looking for a Treasury Analyst to strengthen our Investments & Financial risk team, within Middle Office.

The Treasury department is responsible for all funding, risk- and liquidity management and capital on Group level. NOBA’s main source of funding is deposits from the public, and we have ambitious goals to increase deposit funding in the coming years to support the bank’s overall growth objectives. You will join a committed, positive, and ambitious department that values initiative, ownership, and collaboration. We continuously seek new and better ways to work in a dynamic setting.

About the role

Within Treasury the Investments & Financial Risk team manages the liquidity portfolio, market risks and the middle office operations. The middle office role is the operational backbone of the team and we are now looking for a new team member to take ownership of these responsibilities. You will report to Head of Investments & Financial Risk Management.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage middle office operations

  • Support interim and quarterly reporting alongside the team

  • Manage and support our market risk models

  • Provide reporting and analysis to internal stakeholders and external parties

  • Implement more digital ways of working

  • Contribute to Treasury projects

This is a role where you will be close to both the trading desk and the risk function. If you want to develop in the financial markets within these fields this is a great opportunity.

What we are looking for

  • 2–5 years’ experience in the banking sector, within Treasury, Risk Management, or Back/Middle Office roles in a Treasury or Finance department.

  • A genuine interest in financial markets, understanding of fixed income instruments and how they connect to risk management.

  • Experience working with Treasury system and trading platforms or similar.

  • Experience producing or reviewing risk metrics in a reporting or control capacity.

  • An analytical mindset and comfort working with data; experience with SQL, Python, or similar is a plus.

  • Fluency in Swedish and English.

To thrive in this role, you are a results-oriented team player who takes initiative and has a holistic mindset. You manage tasks with structure, adapt to changes, and are driven to achieve goals while understanding the broader impact of your work.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a Cloud Engineer who enjoys working in the space where developers and infrastructure meet. Here, you’ll spend your time automating the mundane, architecting the complex, and scaling the future of our Azure AI and OpenAI offerings. This role is for you if you find more joy in writing a PowerShell script to solve a recurring app error than in managing a cluster’s networking.

This is a code-centric role where infrastructure is treated as a software product. Everything you build is versioned, reviewed, tested, and continuously improved. Our goal is to reduce repetitive work and create the “Golden Paths” that let developers and AI teams deploy quickly, securely, and reliably. 

About the role:
As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll help build and grow our Azure-based platform. You’ll own the design, automation, and delivery of modular cloud infrastructure, ensuring it’s resilient, scalable, and easy for teams to use. Your work will reduce friction, remove unnecessary steps, and make it simple for developers and data teams to focus on building features instead of worrying about infrastructure.

What you’ll do: 

  • Build the "Golden Path" Pipelines: You won't just "run" pipelines; you will architect them. You’ll design and maintain CI/CD templates (YAML-based) that standardize how our applications are built, tested, and deployed. Your goal is to make the path from code-complete to production-ready as invisible and frictionless as possible for our developers.

  • Automated Application Remediation: We don't believe in manual maintenance. You will use PowerShell and Azure DevOps to build automated pipelines for things like patching the container OS, reporting on deviations and self healing infrastructure

  • Infrastructure as Versioned Code: You’ll design and implement modular Azure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), following the Azure Well-Architected Framework for reliability, performance, and cost.

We are looking for you who have:

  • Expert-level PowerShell skills: We operate in an environment where automation is built on PowerShell first. (Bash & Python are secondary)

  • Proven experience with Azure Bicep: You should be comfortable treating infrastructure as a software product, versioning, testing and modularizing Bicep code.

  • Developer-centric approach: You don't need to be a fullstack developer, but you need to understand application logic enough to automate patching, troubleshoot database connections, and optimize application performance within the cloud.

  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).

You’ll be comfortable owning tasks end to end and making technical decisions independently within the areas listed above. Ideally, you have some years of hands-on experience with Azure, containers, and CI/CD pipelines, but we care more about what you can do and that you enjoy the field, rather than the exact number of years. 

It's positive if you have: 

  • Active Azure certifications such as AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer), AZ-305 (Solutions Architect), AZ-204 (Developer Associate)

  • Experience from regulated or security-conscious environments is a plus 

In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

title: Senior Group Financial Controller med inriktning finansiell rapportering
description:
Vi söker nu en initiativtagande och lösningsorienterad Senior Group Financial Controller som vill vara med på vår spännande tillväxtresa och driva utvecklingen av koncernens finansiella rapportering.  

NOBA Bank Group består idag av fyra varumärken; Nordax Bank, dotterbolagen Svensk Hypotekspension och DBT Capital samt filialen Bank Norwegian. Vi är nu cirka 800 anställda i koncernen, har cirka 2 miljoner kunder och opererar på flera marknader i Norden och Europa. Vi befinner oss på en spännande tillväxtresa och förväntar oss att växa både organiskt och genom förvärv. I september 2025 börsnoterades NOBA, vilket innebär att vi nu verkar i en noterad miljö och med ännu högre krav på kvalitet, transparens och rapportering.  

Du kommer att tillhöra Group Accounting som består av 3-4 personer. Vi arbetar tvärfunktionellt och i nära samarbete med bland annat Accounting, Investor Relations och Business Control. Vi är ett litet team och söker därför dig som är prestigelös och hjälper dina kollegor när det behövs. 

Om rollen 

Som Senior Group Financial Controller med inriktning på finansiell rapportering har du huvudansvaret för upprättande och kvalitetssäkring av våra finansiella rapporter, såsom kvartalsrapporter, årsredovisning och rapportering av ESEF. Du säkerställer att rapporterna är högkvalitativa, begripliga och ger värdefull och relevant information till aktieägare och andra intressenter. En nyckelkomponent i detta arbete är att säkerställa att våra finansiella rapporter efterlever IFRS och lagbegränsad IFRS.  

Du kommer även att arbeta med månadsvis konsolidering och säkerställa effektiviteten och kvaliteten i den interna kontrollen över finansiell rapportering (ICFR) inom gruppens ansvarsområde. En del av detta arbete innebär att du är med och kravställer på legala enheter inom koncernen för att säkerställa korrekt och komplett finansiell information. Du stöttar också Accounting-teamet i redovisnings- och rapporteringsfrågor vid behov. 

Vem vi söker: 

  • Civilekonomexamen eller motsvarande akademisk examen inom ekonomi 

  • Gedigen erfarenhet (minst 5-6 år) av att upprätta årsredovisning och kvartalsrapporter, gärna inom bank, andra finansiella eller noterade bolag 

  • Erfarenhet av tillämpning av IFRS

  • Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med automatisering och effektivisering av finansiella rapporter 

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift 

Meriterande:  

  • Erfarenhet av regulatorisk rapportering (Standardrapport, MFI och/eller MIR) 

  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med CtrlPrint, Integrate eller InDesign 

Som person hoppas vi att du är noggrann, strukturerad och självgående, med förmåga att både planera och organisera arbetet. Rollen kräver att du har öga för detaljer samtidigt som du kan se helheten. title: Credit Risk Analyst – Non-Performing Loans (NPLs)
description:
NOBA Bank Group is looking for a driven Credit Risk Analyst with a strong focus on analyzing and managing Non-Performing Loans (NPLs). You will join the Group Portfolio Analytics team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the analytics and reporting infrastructure that supports NOBA’s continued growth and sound risk management. 

NOBA holds a market-leading position in the Nordics, and the NPL team manages a substantial share of the region’s non-performing loan portfolios, amounting to a net value of c. 11bn SEK. This role offers hands-on exposure to large, complex portfolios, high-quality data, and analytical work that directly influences both commercial and risk-related decisions. 

You’ll be key part of a talented group of experienced and highly skilled colleagues across the organization, where your expertise will help shape decision-making and drive continuous improvements in how NPL portfolios are analyzed, managed, and finally divested. 

About the role:

As a Credit Risk Analyst at NOBA, you will play a central role in developing and strengthening how NPL portfolios are managed across the bank. Working closely with a cross-functional NPL team, you will combine hands-on data analysis with a strong business understanding to deliver insights that support portfolio performance, strategy, and sales activities related to NPLs. 

Main tasks:

  • Delivering data-driven insights to maximize value creation from NOBA’s NPL portfolio 

  • Building and maintaining a strong understanding of collection data across countries and brands 

  • Designing, maintaining, and continuously improving group-wide NPL reporting, covering:  

    • Debt collection performance 

    • Group NPE strategy 

    • Performance of securitized NPL portfolios  

  • Ensure availability, accuracy, and consistency of data and reports across the Group enabling best-in-class management of NPLs. 

  • Support NPL sales and divestments, including analytical and reporting deliverables 

  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders such as Risk Control, Finance, Collections, Underwriting, and Data Engineering 

  • Work with external debt collection agencies and partners on data extraction, quality, and reporting. 

We are looking for you who:

  • 3+ years of experience in analytical roles and NPL-related fields, preferably within banking or credit risk. 

  • A degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. engineering, economics, statistics, or similar) 

  • Strong technical skills in one or more of: SAS, SQL, Python, R 

  • A self-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong prioritization skills 

  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management abilities 

  • Professional proficiency in English and at least one Scandinavian language 

It's positive if you also bring:

  • Experience analyzing debt collection agency (DCA) performance 

  • Experience producing reports for financial authorities (e.g. SFSA) 

  • Hands-on experience with statistical methods such as A/B testing or regression analysis 

  • Experience working across Nordic markets 


To thrive and perform well in the role, we believe that:

You enjoy taking the lead, improving ways of working, and developing how data is used to drive better outcomes. You build trust through clear communication and collaboration, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and can balance strategic thinking with attention to detail. If you thrive in complex challenges, value high ownership, and want to make a visible impact at one of Europe’s largest specialist banks – this role is for you. 

In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst
description:
At Bank Norwegian and Nordax Bank, we believe in simplicity, transparency, and technology-driven innovation. As part of NOBA Bank Group, we offer consumer loans, credit cards, savings accounts and insurance – all made available through cutting-edge technology, automation, and seamless self-service platforms.

With over 2 million customers across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Germany, and Spain, we’re proud to be part of the largest independent specialist consumer finance lender in the Nordics – and we’re just getting started.

Whether you're located in Oslo (Fornebu) or Stockholm (Gävlegatan 22), this is an opportunity to join a bank that is growing fast and shaping the future of consumer finance in Europe.

About the role:
Our Credit & Analytics department is known for being one of the most forward-thinking in the Nordics, made up of talents from across the globe. Within this department, the Credit Underwriting & Decision Analytics unit focuses on continuously improving our automated underwriting processes and monitoring risk performance.

As our unsecured portfolios across the Nordics grow in both size and complexity, we’re now looking for a Senior Credit Risk Analyst to join us on this exciting journey and help influence our future solutions. Credit underwriting is within the absolute core for a bank operating within unsecured credits. Working and coordinating with stakeholders from multiple departments is essential, and internally we simply refer to this role as having the day-to-day responsibility for “running the bank”

Main tasks:

  • Having complete responsibility for a portfolio from a credit risk perspective

  • Consistently analyze assigned portfolios to identify underwriting (UW) opportunities and risks, delivering actionable recommendations based on analysis and investigation

  • Maintain a strong overview of the country portfolio, understanding key figures, trends and effects of UW changes

  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional initiatives for underwriting changes, improvements and effectively managing input from key stakeholders

  • Develop and enhance risk reporting using advanced analytical tools

  • Engage in the bank’s model validation activities and ensure compliance with regulatory standards and internal guidelines

  • Support strategic growth initiatives by conducting deep-dive analyses across products and markets

  • Identify untapped data opportunities and turn them into actionable insights

  • Collaborate on other tasks within Credit Underwriting & Decision Analytics to support our continuous improvement journey

We are looking for you who:

  • Fluency in English (Scandinavian language skills is a plus)

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience working within credit risk in the Nordic countries

  • Strong communication skills – ability to explain complex findings in an understandable way

  • Working experience from using analytical tools such R, Python, SAS or SQL/Databricks

  • A degree in a quantitative field (Economics, Statistics, Data Science or similar)

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with reporting tools such as Tableau or Power BI

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Experience of working with B2B.

  • Experience of working within the Norwegian or the Finnish market


Who you are:
Knowing it’s a lot to ask for, but if you are creative, curious and have strong analytical skills at the same time, we think you could make a huge impact on our business. You are eager to use data and willing to challenge and improve existing methods. You enjoy both working independently and collaborating closely with others.

In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Are you looking for a role where your engineering skills create real business value? As a Data Engineer in Bank Norwegian at NOBA Bank Group, you’ll help transform raw data into structured, high-quality assets. You’ll play a key role in modernizing our data landscape, adopting new technologies, and enabling the organization to innovate and grow.

About the role:

The Data & Analytics Engineering department brings together specialists in data infrastructure, analytics, and data management. Together we build a modern and reliable data foundation that supports decision-making across the business.

In this role, you’ll design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines, partner with teams across the bank, and ensure that business-critical data needs are met. This is a great opportunity to grow your expertise, collaborate broadly, and see the tangible results of your work.

We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team-building, and enjoying fikas and after-work gatherings together!

Main tasks:

  • Design, build, and maintain efficient data pipelines for reliable acquisition, transformation, and integration.

  • Develop data models that support scalable and well-structured data usage.

  • Safeguard data quality, security, and compliance throughout the lifecycle.

  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders such as Risk, Finance, and IT to ensure business needs are met.

  • Enhance data usage and accessibility by applying modern data engineering practices.

We are looking for you who:

Enjoys working with data engineering, solving technical challenges, and building solutions that make data both accessible and reliable.

We believe you are proactive and detail-oriented, with a genuine curiosity for new technologies. You thrive in collaboration, approach challenges with a “can-do” mindset, and enjoy turning complex problems into practical solutions. 

For this role, you’ll need:

  • Experience working in a similar role within Data Engineering

  • An academic degree related to the data or software engineering field

  • Proficiency in ETL processes and data logic, with an understanding of how data is sourced, transformed, and presented to data users.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft’s cloud-based data stack (SQL, Power BI, Azure, etc.).

  • Experience with Databricks.

  • Strong English skills, with a good understanding of Norwegian and/or Swedish.

It's positive if you have: 

  • Experience with additional BI and programming tools (e.g., dbt, Python).

  • A background in data roles within the financial sector.

  • Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies.

Our offer to you

  • Freedom with responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style.

  • Career development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role.

  • Feedback culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication.

  • Coaching leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey.

You’ll also have the chance to work with cutting-edge data technologies and be part of shaping the future of NOBA’s data landscape.

title: Bolånehandläggare till svenska bolåneteamet (Vikariat)
description:
Som bolånehandläggare hos oss arbetar du i ett härligt team på nio personer, där vi tillsammans driver försäljning av bolån på den svenska marknaden. Vi tar emot ansökningar från brokers och från kunder som söker direkt på vår hemsida, vi gör bedömningar och kalkyler samt följer ansökningarna hela vägen till utbetalning. Parallellt håller vi kontakten med kunder och brokers för att skapa långsiktiga relationer och bidra till teamets välmående och framgång. 🤝🏽

Denna roll är ett vikariat på cirka 1 år för att täcka upp för föräldraledighet.


Om rollen:
I rollen som bolånehandläggare är du en viktig del av teamet och ansvarar för att driva försäljning och hantera ansökningar på den svenska bolånemarknaden. Du arbetar nära både kunder och brokers och bidrar till både individuella och gemensamma mål. 🌟

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

  • Ta emot och bedöma ansökningar från brokers samt utföra kalkyler

  • Efterfråga kompletteringar och sammanställa ansökningar till kreditbeslut

  • Handlägga ansökningar och konvertera till utbetalade lån

  • Ha löpande kontakt med kunder och bygga relationer med brokers

  • Arbeta mot individuella mål och teamets gemensamma mål (försäljning och kundnöjdhet)

  • Delta i förbättringsarbete och utvecklingsprojekt inom teamet

Vem är du?

  • Erfarenhet av försäljning och av bolån

  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta mot uppsatta mål och KPI:er

  • Talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Det är meriterande om du har: 

  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi, juridik eller mäkleri

  • Tidigare arbetat på nischbank  

Vi söker dig som är driven av resultat, analytisk och lösningsorienterad. Du har förmåga att prioritera, tänka utanför boxen och är inte rädd för att ta ansvar. Du trivs i en prestigelös miljö där du gärna hjälper kollegor och ser teamets framgång som din egen. Du är flexibel, strukturerad och motiveras av att bygga relationer med både brokers och kunder. Att arbeta mot mål och utvecklas tillsammans med andra är något som inspirerar dig! ✨

title: Finnish-speaking Customer Advisor to Pre-Collections
description:
Are you a great listener with a genuine desire to help others? At Pre- Collections you will get the chance to build your communication skills, work closely with a fantastic team and develop valuable knowledge in credit and risk – all in a fun, energetic and inclusive environment where your voice is heard and your growth matters. 🌱

The Pre-Collections team is a vital part of our business. By phone we proactively reach out to customers who have fallen behind on their payments and support them in finding the best way forward. Sometimes it is a simple fix and other times it means building a long-term plan together. You will also take incoming calls from customers who need help. While there is some administration involved in the role, this is mainly a phone-based service role where your communication skills truly make a difference.

About the role
As a Customer Advisor, you will play a key role in helping our customers get back on track with their payments by building trust with customer focus. You will communicate with empathy, find solutions together with the customer and contribute to a positive and proactive team environment that also focuses on team results. At the same time, it is important that you feel confident setting clear expectations in the customer dialogue – and when needed, making firm but respectful demands regarding overdue payments to prevent the loan going to debt collection 🤝

Good to know
The role is based at our office in Stockholm, but if you are located elsewhere in Sweden, there is an opportunity to work remotely by agreement.

Main tasks

  • Make outbound calls to customers who have overdue payments

  • Guide customers toward sustainable payment solutions

  • Handle incoming calls and assist with questions or concerns

  • Perform light administration linked to customer cases

  • Contribute to a customer-first mindset with a warm and professional attitude

Who are you?

  • You speak Finnish and English fluently

  • You have experience in customer service, preferably over the phone

It is a bonus if:

  • You also speak Swedish

  • You have worked with Collections or Pre-collections

We also believe that you are:

title: Finnish speaking Customer Advisor to Pre-Collections (Part-time)
description:
Please note that we are not able to hire people that live in Finland. To be able to work with us, you need to be located in the Stockholm area, as the office is our main place to work. 

We are now looking for new part time colleagues, as we call "temps", to Pre-Collections. Pre-Collections is an outbound-focused role where you will primarily contact customers who, for various reasons, have fallen behind on their payments. In some cases, there are simple solutions, while in others, you will need to work with the customer to develop a long-term payment plan. You will also handle some inbound calls from customers who reach out to us. Alongside the calls, there is some administrative work, but the role itself is phone-based, which is why we are looking for someone who enjoys customer interaction and sees every conversation as an opportunity to help!📞

To succeed in this role, it is important that you are engaged and proactive - both in customer interactions and in your own development. We value team members who actively contribute to discussions and meetings, even in situations where they may not yet have the deepest expertise. 💡

We operate in a highly regulated industry, and it is crucial that you understand the responsibility that comes with working at a bank, especially in adhering to the regulatory frameworks we must follow. Examples of relevant regulations include GDPR, banking secrecy, AML (Anti-Money Laundering) regulations, and identity verification requirements. We must also be mindful of how we communicate with our customers, both verbally and in writing. 📓✔️🖊️

Training:
This position starts with a full-time introduction for three weeks in the office. In order for you to have good conditions to start working, attendance as high as possible is required during these two weeks. After the two weeks, while you are still in training, the shifts will be scheduled during daytime in the office. When you can work independently, you will also have the option to work from home. 

The role is based at our office in Stockholm, but if you are located elsewhere, there is an opportunity to work remotely by agreement.

Shifts:
Your shifts will mostly be scheduled during the 30th-5th and 15th-17th every month. 

To thrive and perform well in the role, we believe that you need to be:

  • Service-oriented & communicative: You have the ability to listen and understand different people’s needs while also having the confidence to set clear expectations in conversations. 🌱

  • Results-driven: You are motivated by achieving results and goals, such as customer satisfaction. 🏆

  • Flexible: You can adapt to different situations that arise at work and excel at prioritizing tasks. 🤸‍♀️

It is also important that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

We are looking for you who:

  • Have worked with service/people in some way, preferably over the phone

  • Speaks and writes fluently in Finnish and English, preferably Swedish as well

  • Can and want to work part-time for at least 1 year (hopefully longer!)

description:

Brinner du för att hjälpa människor, älskar kundkontakt och drivs av tydliga mål? Då kan detta vara din nästa karriärmöjlighet! Som Sales Associate på Resurs blir du en viktig del i vårt ambitiösa team, där vi ständigt motiverar och utmanar varandra för att nå resultat tillsammans.

Om rollen

I rollen som Sales Associate hjälper du våra kunder till en tryggare och smartare privatekonomi. Genom både utgående samtal till befintliga kunder och inkommande ärenden via telefon och webb, kartlägger du kundernas behov och erbjuder lösningar som gör skillnad.

Med en bred produktportfölj – som samlingslån, betalförsäkringar, kreditkort och sparkonton – guidar du kunderna rätt, samtidigt som du bygger långsiktiga relationer och bidrar till teamets gemensamma framgång.

Dina arbetsuppgifter: 

  • Kartlägga kunders behov och erbjuda skräddarsydda lösningar 

  • Arbeta med ett brett produktutbud inom lån, försäkringar, kreditkort och sparande 

  • Bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och skapa trygghet genom hela kundresan

  • Driva din egen försäljning och arbeta målinriktat för att nå KPI:er och försäljningsmål

  • Delta i daglig coaching, pulsmöten och bidra till teamets energi och resultat

Vi tror att du har:

  • Fömåga att skapa förtroende och bygga relationer via telefon och digitala kanaler

  • Struktur i ditt administrativa arbete och förmåga att hålla ordning även under intensiva perioder 

  • En målfokuserad och lösningsorienterad inställning, utan att tumma på kundupplevelsen 

  • Erfarenhet av försäljning är meriterande – men viktigast är din potential och vilja att utvecklas 

  • En positiv attityd som smittar av sig på både kunder och kollegor

Vi söker dig som kombinerar driv, energi och en passion för kundservice. Du är en god kommunikatör, trivs i en snabbföränderlig miljö och vill utvecklas inom försäljning.

Varför välja Resurs?

Hos oss på Resurs är du mer än bara en säljare – du är en viktig del av vår resa framåt. Vi erbjuder en modern arbetsplats i fräscha lokaler på vårt huvudkontor på Väla, Helsingborg. Vi har trygga anställningsvillkor och kollektivavtal, och alla anställda omfattas av förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag, massage, subventionerad lunch m.m.

Ansök genom att skicka in ditt CV och en video – enkelt och personligt. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning.

Viktigt att känna till: På slutkandidater genomför vi en utförlig bakgrundskontroll via ett externt bolag.

title: Early Collection Associate - Danish speaking
description:
We are looking for Early Collection Associates to strengthen our early‑stage collection work and help our customers get back on track. You will handle our danish customers, so being fluent in danish both in speech and in writing is a requirement. You will play a key role in supporting our responsible lending practices, contributing to customer satisfaction, and reducing the flow of cases into late‑stage collection, while working closely with both internal stakeholders and external Debt Collection Agencies (DCAs).

Get an idea of the role


As an Early Collection Associate at Resurs, you will combine customer‑focused communication with structured administrative work across the entire early collection chain. You will manage both inbound and outbound customer contacts, handle complex cases, and collaborate closely with external partners to secure efficient and compliant recovery processes.

You will take ownership of your cases end‑to‑end, ensuring that each interaction is handled with clarity, professionalism, and respect for the customer situation, while always safeguarding the Bank’s interests and regulatory requirements.

You will also:

  • Manage inbound customer communication across all existing channels, providing efficient, compliant, and customer‑centric responses to inquiries.

  • Conduct outbound phone communication to remind customers of payments and establish high‑quality payment agreements, driving strong promise‑to‑pay outcomes and customer loyalty.

  • Handle administrative processes throughout the early collection lifecycle, including debt restructuring, deceased estates, bankruptcies, disputes, pre‑legal cases, and other relevant matters.

  • Collaborate closely with external Debt Collection Agencies by providing day‑to‑day support, documentation, responses to customer‑related inquiries, and negotiating mandates for externally managed claims.

We have two open positions; one is a permanent employment, and the other is a temporary position for 6 month.


On a personal level


To thrive in this role, we believe you are a structured and resilient professional who feels comfortable navigating sensitive customer situations. You communicate with empathy, clarity, and confidence, and you are motivated by finding solutions that work for both the customer and the Bank.

You enjoy taking ownership, managing multiple cases in parallel, and working in a regulated environment where accuracy and compliance are essential. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you value clear processes and continuous improvement.

We also believe that you:

  • Have completed a high school education.

  • Have 2–5 years of professional experience, regardless of field.

  • Are fluent in both spoken and written Danish - this is a mandatory requirement for the role.

Resurs in brief

At Resurs, we make everyday finances easier through innovative and customer-focused solutions. With customers across the Nordics and more than 800 colleagues, we are committed to creating long-term value for individuals, businesses, and society. Recognized as a career company for the past six years, we put strong emphasis on both personal and professional growth. We want to make a difference by striving to be our best, acting with kindness, and building trust through clarity and collaboration. Our heart beats strong and it shows in everything we do.

Although we are based in the Nordics, our team is enriched by the breadth of perspectives brought by colleagues from different countries. We foster a welcoming and supportive culture, where collaboration drives us to achieve the best outcomes for our users.

Apply today!

Don’t wait to send in your application. Selection and interviews take place on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the last application date.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Important information

On final candidates, we carry out a detailed background check via an external company.

You will be part of the compliance function and work closely with the Head of Compliance, your compliance colleagues, the Financial Crime Prevention team and the business. In this position, you will play a central role in shaping how the bank works with AML/CFT going forward, ensuring that the framework is robust, business-anchored, and aligned with both regulatory expectations and organisational needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • monitor and regularly control compliance with AML/CFT legislation in the Nordic countries where the Bank operates as well as with internal rules and regulations

  • assessing and following up on AML/CFT issues

  • ensuring reporting of suspicious activities and transactions and answering to requests from the FIUs

  • reporting to the CEO and the Board

  • monitoring regulatory developments and assessing their impact for the Bank

  • providing qualified support to the business in matters relating to new products, process changes, and system improvements as well as other implications for the business of AML/CFT rules

  • audit, monitor and control internal procedures, guidelines and AML/CFT measures in place and assess whether they are compliant, appropriate and effective and provide recommendations based on findings

  • General AML/CFT training

This is a role for someone who enjoys combining specialist depth with influence in the business. You will have the opportunity to work close to decision-making, contribute to a strategically important area, and play a meaningful part in the bank’s continued development.

As the regulatory landscape continues to evolve, not least through the AML Package, this role also offers scope for someone who is adaptable, forward-looking, and motivated by helping shape an area that will continue to change over time.

About you

We are looking for a senior AML professional with strong hands-on experience and the confidence to take independent ownership of a specialist area.

To succeed in this role, we believe you bring:

  • at least five years of relevant AML experience

  • very strong experience from the second line of defence

  • experience from a bank, payment institution, fintech company, or another regulatory complex business

  • fluency in Swedish and English

A law degree is an advantage, but not a requirement. What matters most is your ability to interpret and apply regulations, technical standards, and legal frameworks in practice.

You are confident, self-driven, and comfortable making independent assessments. At the same time, you are structured, pragmatic, and able to move things forward in a changing business environment. We also believe that you are curious, forward-looking, and motivated by improving ways of working.

Experience in developing and delivering training is a requirement, and an interest in technology, AI, and new ways of working is a clear advantage.

title: Fraud Analyst
description:
Are you driven by analytics, automation, and stopping fraud before it happens? Join our fintech bank and help us design the next generation of data-driven fraud prevention in Sweden.

As a Fraud Analyst, you will work at the intersection of data science, risk, and real-time decisioning. You will develop, test, and optimize fraud detection models across lending, cards, and payments. Your analyses will directly influence risk appetite, customer experience, and portfolio performance.

You will:

  • Analyze large, complex datasets to detect fraud patterns and emerging attack vectors

  • Develop and maintain fraud models, rules, and monitoring frameworks

  • Build dashboards and reporting that translate risk signals into actionable insight

This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving environment where your work directly impacts loss rates, approval rates, and customer trust.

Who you are

  • 5+ years’ experience in data science, analytics, or quantitative risk roles within a bank, fintech or related industry

  • Strong knowledge of machine learning, statistical modeling, and model validation

  • Advanced SQL and Python (R is a plus)

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, SAS)

  • Comfortable working with large datasets and production-grade decision systems

  • Able to translate complex analysis into clear, business-driven recommendations

  • Experience in financial fraud prevention or fraud risk management is highly meriting

You are analytical, commercially minded, and motivated by solving adversarial problems in real time. You thrive in a fintech environment where speed, ownership, and impact matter.
